description: What a deposit must or should have (ADR-0038). A standard's set covers any record in one metadata standard and names it in re3data_names; a repository override adds what one repository asks and names it in re3data_id. The harness merges the two for the repository a researcher chose, checks the project against the result, and gives it to the drafters. Kept as YAML in the deployment's configuration, not sent by agents.

schema_class.description: Type designator: the name of the class this object is an instance of. Discriminates the input and payload unions, and lets a consumer name a payload class it does not recognise.

requirement_set_id.description: Identifies the requirement set, such as datacite-4 or orda.

version.description: The version of the set, raised on every change.

title.description: What a person calls the standard or the repository.

url.description: Where the standard or the repository is described.

conforms_to.description: The URI of the metadata schema. An override names the standard's set it builds on.

re3data_names.description: A standard's set only: the metadataStandardName values in re3data that select it.

re3data_id.description: An override only: the repository's re3data identifier, such as r3d100012124.

fields.description: The metadata properties the set requires or recommends.

required_documents.description: The document kinds that must have an approved version before a package is built.

recommended_documents.description: The document kinds whose absence is a warning.

media_types.description: An override only: the media types the repository accepts. Empty means any.

max_file_size.description: An override only: the largest file the repository accepts, in bytes.

max_item_size.description: An override only: the largest deposit the repository accepts, in bytes.

licences.description: An override only: the licences the repository offers, each an SPDX identifier or the URL of the repository's own terms.

guidance.description: The pages the set's values were taken from, so that a steward can check them.
